title: Hexagons
statementMd:
Ayrat is looking for the perfect code. He decided to start his search from an infinite field tiled by hexagons. For convenience the coordinate system is introduced, take a look at the picture to see how the coordinates of hexagon are defined:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3b2337e9f4aadba64c4f33339db20ad466e772b7.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5662ae948778adbfe5476af10bd0c1c576d7afb1.png) Ayrat is searching through the field. He started at point $(0, 0)$ and is moving along the spiral (see second picture). Sometimes he forgets where he is now. Help Ayrat determine his location after $*n*$ moves.

## Input

The only line of the input contains integer $*n*$ ($0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$) — the number of Ayrat's moves.

## Output

Print two integers $*x*$ and $*y*$ — current coordinates of Ayrat coordinates.
statementZhMd:
Ayrat 正在寻找完美的代码。他决定从一片由六边形铺成的无限场地开始他的探索。为了方便起见，引入了坐标系，请查看图片以了解六边形坐标的定义：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3b2337e9f4aadba64c4f33339db20ad466e772b7.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5662ae948778adbfe5476af10bd0c1c576d7afb1.png) Ayrat 正在探索这片场地。他从点 $(0, 0)$ 出发，并沿着螺旋线移动（见第二张图片）。有时他会忘记自己现在所在的位置。请帮助 Ayrat 确定经过 $*n*$ 次移动后他所在的位置。

## 输入格式

输入的唯一一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$）——Ayrat 移动的次数。

## 输出格式

输出两个整数 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$——Ayrat 当前所在位置的坐标。
